about: Modwerk source-only chorus package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/chorus. A send effect: the site builds it on the Modwerk base's send-bus variant.

mods.title: CHORUS
mods.summary: A stereo chorus for the Rytm's send bus: two swept taps, the right side out of phase, with feedback and its own high- and low-pass.
mods.description: A stereo chorus for the Rytm's send bus: two swept taps, the right side out of phase, with feedback and its own high- and low-pass.
mods.author: stigmagit
mods.on_unit: Test build MB02, with the same source built locally, ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as the author reported; this package has not run on a unit.
